text:
Marta Lopez: Flagging logistics  candidate Elena Garcia is invited for a split-site loop Mon. AM with NYC Eng team (8:00am ET remote) and PM onsite at SF office (3:00pm PT). Shes willing to fly same day but asked if we can cover a same-day domestic flight and arrival transfer + checked-bag storage. Also asked about a quiet room between flights. Can people-ops advise policy and feasibility?

Devon Blake: Im the hiring manager for SF panel  3:00-4:30 PT. If travel is tight we can move to hybrid but prefer an in-person afternoon. I can be flexible by 30 mins.

people-ops: Quick policy note  for cross-campus same-day travel we usually preapprove one-way airfare + local transfer up to $400; overnight hotel only if flight windows are infeasible. We can prepay the flight and hold a same-day locker for bags. Do we have candidate flight details?

Marta Lopez: She hasnt booked. Candidate prefers an early red-eye from JFK to SFO arriving ~1:30pm PT. Shes OK with one checked bag. Also requested assistance with expedited airport-to-office transfer and an accessible quiet room for 2 hours if the flight is delayed.

travel-bot: We can prebook a refundable same-day flight up to $380 and a rideshare from SFO to office (max $75). Please confirm candidate name as on ID for ticketing and whether she needs TSA Pre/Global Entry voucher.

people-ops: Sounds doable. @facilities can you reserve a quiet room (single-occupancy) from 1:304:30 PT and a day locker for a checked bag? Also coordinate reception to meet the candidate at curb if flight arrives early.

facilities: Reserved Quiet Room Q3 from 12:30-16:00 PT and Locker L7 for the day (temporary code set). Reception will be on curb pickup duty for arrivals 13:00-15:00. We'll leave a small cooler space in case candidate needs to store lunch/medication.

Marta Lopez: Candidate also asked whether she can do the morning NYC panel from a reserved conference room in SF (to avoid timezone hassle)  basically cross-site video link so shes not at home. Is that allowed and can we book a room with good AV?

people-ops: Yes we can book a conference room with AV and a dedicated Zoom link for the 8:00am ET slot (which is 5:00am PT though). Question: 8:00am ET equals 5:00am PT; is the candidate expecting to be on SF campus that early? Marta, you sure the morning is 8:00am ET not 9:00am?

Marta Lopez: Confirmed with NYC team  it's 8:00am ET. Elena said she can do remote but prefers a quiet room on campus to take the call and avoid home distractions. Shed rather leave after the call to catch a late-morning flight.

Devon Blake: If she leaves after the 8am call, flight options to make the 3pm SF panel are tight but possible. Travel-bot, please search for flights departing after 9:30am ET arriving SFO by 1:30pm PT and quote refundable fares. If none, we either move the SF panel later or switch to hybrid.

travel-bot: Searching... Best refundable itinerary found: Delta DL123 departs JFK 10:05am ET, arrives SFO 1:40pm PT (1 stop) $365 refundable. Direct options depart after 11:00 and arrive after 2:45pm which is risky. Recommend booking DL123 and blocking a 2:003:30 buffer before panel start.

people-ops: Booking recommendation accepted. We'll prepay DL123 and rideshare. Candidate to be asked about luggage  if she checks a bag we reserve an extra 45 mins for pickup. Marta, want us to hold the 3:00pm panel start at 3:30 as fallback?

Marta Lopez: Yes please tentatively move start to 3:30 PT and tell panelists we may start as early as 3:00 if she clears in time. Devon, ok?

Devon Blake: Fine  I'll shift my calendar to 3:30-5:00 PT window. Please flag me if we can start earlier.

people-ops: Noted. Travel bookings will include a pick-up at SFO with a Meet & Greet sign and immediate Reception escort. We'll also add a printed itinerary and backup Zoom link in the candidate packet.

recruiter-bot: Reached out to candidate for legal name, DOB for ticketing, and bag preference. Also sent the questionnaire asking whether candidate wants prepaid rideshare or transit reimbursement. Calendar event created: "Elena Garcia  Split-site: NYC AM / SF PM" Tentative 05:00-06:00 PT (NYC panel room) and 15:30-17:00 PT (SF onsite). Flight and transfer attached pending candidate confirmation.

Marta Lopez: One more: she asked about a vegetarian + pescatarian lunch possibility and whether we can provide a quiet place to pump if needed. Also asked if we can store a small medication kit on-site.

people-ops: We'll mark lunch dietary preference in packet (veg/pesc). Quiet room Q3 doubles as private pumping space if required. We'll arrange a small sealed meds box at Reception labeled with candidate name and instructions.

facilities: Added meds box note and fridge shelf. Q3 has lock and sink. AV-tested 8:00am ET room  good to go.

travel-bot: Tentative flight prebooked for hold. Please confirm candidate details by EOD to ticket. If candidate prefers not to fly same day, we can reimburse an overnight hotel and move SF panel to next day.

Marta Lopez: I'll DM candidate now and push for confirmation. If we get confirmation we'll send final packet and ticket. Thanks team  closing loop unless we need to change plans. :white_check_mark:
